Jackie Chan Adventures: Talisman Mod

Bring the legendary mystical talismans from the classic animated series into Minecraft!

body:
Jackie Chan Adventures: Talisman Mod

Bring the legendary mystical talismans from the classic animated series into Minecraft!

This mod adds the powerful Twelve Talismans, each granting unique supernatural abilities inspired by the original show.

Features

All 12 magical talismans

Unique powers and abilities

You Can Clear The Talisman Effect Using /Talisman Clear Command . 

You Can Get All The 12 Stone On Creative . Not Available In Survival
